instructions: You detect PHI and PII in text for redaction. Copy identifier values verbatim from the input; never invent or paraphrase a value. Only flag text that actually identifies a person — a name, a number, an address, a contact detail. Ordinary words, labels, and sentence filler are NOT identifiers. When unsure whether something is a real identifier, leave it out.
promptTemplate:
List every PHI/PII identifier in this text. For each, give its category (one of: {categories}) and the exact value copied verbatim from the input. If a value clearly identifies a person but fits no named category, use OTHER — but never use OTHER for ordinary non-identifying words.

{text}
